title: Make a shape
description: Every game starts with something you can see. This one is just a shape on a canvas.
hint: Look at the shape in the preview. There is nothing to click yet — you control it with the settings below.
challenge: Can you make a small mint triangle?

title: Make it clickable
description: Give the shape a job: every tap adds to a score. A game remembers what you do.
hint: Click or tap the square three times. Watch the number underneath it.
challenge: Make each click worth 5, then reach 20 points.

title: Move it around
description: Movement is a small change in position. The arrow buttons and keyboard do the same thing.
hint: Use the arrow buttons in the game to reach the outline. On a keyboard, click the game first, then use the arrow keys or WASD.
challenge: Try a bigger step. Is it easier or harder to reach the goal?

title: Drag and drop
description: A drag has a beginning, a movement, and an end. The square follows your mouse or finger until you let go.
hint: Grab the square, drag it into the outline, and release it.
challenge: Turn on the grid and notice how the square snaps into place.

title: Give it a sound
description: Sound makes an action feel different. These sounds are files included with the game.
hint: Click or tap the square to hear it. Your first tap also enables sound in the browser.
challenge: Swap Chime for Pop. Which would you use for collecting a coin?

title: Play together
description: Now the same game has more than one player. Everyone sees the score, and the game knows their names.
hint: Open the Homegames menu above the game and open its invitation link in another tab. Take turns tapping the square. Keep this example open; changing its controls restarts the session.
challenge: Change your player name from the game menu. Watch the names update for both players.

title: Make it move
description: A tick loop advances the game even when nobody clicks. Speed is measured in game units per second.
hint: Watch the square bounce off both edges.
challenge: Double the speed. The scene still updates 30 times per second.

title: Win and restart
description: A round needs a goal, an ending, and a way to play again. These are changes to game state.
hint: Tap the square until you win, then tap again to restart.
challenge: Change the goal. Check that holding the square still counts as one tap.
